text:
Sam: Quick follow-up on last night's latency burst (p95 spikes). Need owners for SLO adjustments, runbook edits, and dashboard alerts.

Nina: Root cause looked like cache cold-shard fanout. I recommend a short-lived canary SLO label (canary-p95=360ms) only for the canary cohort for 48h. Will draft PR.

Carlos: I'll take dashboards/alerts. Plan: add error-budget burn panel, p95 panel with markers at 300ms & 360ms, and a composite alert: p95>360ms AND kv_miss_rate>0.04 for 10m. ETA: Tue EOD.

Sam: Assign actions: Carlos -> dashboard (SRE-601), Nina -> runbook + prewarm script (SRE-602), Sam -> canary policy + automation (SRE-603). AlertBot create epic.

AlertBot: Epic SRE-EPIC-980 created. Linked incidents 312-2026. Issues: SRE-601, SRE-602, SRE-603.

Nina: Runbook snippet I'll add includes prewarm trigger when kv_miss_rate > 0.05 for 3m and a test case in CI.

Carlos: Dashboard query examples I'll put in the PR: 
```
# p95
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
and an hourly burn calc.

Sam: Error-budget rule: allow canary to consume up to 35% of team's budget; auto-throttle if 1h burn >25%. I'll draft automation for rollback.

Nina: OK. I'll open SRE-602 PR today and link tests.

Carlos: PR placeholder for SRE-601 created. Will add docs note about interpreting burn gauges.

Sam: Excellent. I'll run twice-weekly 15m check-ins for 2 weeks and close epic after one clean window. :thumbsup:
